device.systemGles: GLES: Qualcomm, Adreno (TM) 830, OpenGL ES 3.2 V@0800.64.8

renderer: Same arm64 Rust GLES3 renderer and six packaged game files in every lane. Native replay uses the WebView-profile APK without starting a WebView.

actorOracle.recipe: Select authored pose 1 pixels (24+x,24+y) with 0<=x<24 and 0<=y<33; skip nonopaque pixels. Sample the held viewport at stage (149+(x+0.5)*1.25,128+(y+0.5)*1.25), rounding down after scaling to viewport pixels.

wrongDigest.error: Project benchmark: java.io.IOException: Replay tape differs from the expected capture SHA-256

performance.method: Four process-cold starts per lane, with a 4x4 Latin square. Warm filesystem/app data including installed ICU. First 30 submitted callbacks excluded, then 180 samples at each start. Per-run nearest-rank p50 and p95. Medians across four runs average the middle pair. PSS is measured after terminal frame hold and includes identified WebView child processes. Replay startup includes reading and verifying the preloaded tape. Script timers are null during native replay. No GPU or presentation timestamps.
